format: NDCA Sanctioned events, officials who may hold ballot access

source.quote_free_summary: At least one NDCA-certified Scrutineer must officiate; the Scrutineer may not serve as Chairman of Adjudicators; judges' cards are collected by a steward and delivered to the Scrutineer.

requirement: Chairman and Scrutineer are separate event-level designations held by different accounts; neither is derived from a DanceFlow account role or official role; certification is an organizer attestation, not verified by DanceFlow.
interpretation_notes: DanceFlow cannot verify NDCA certification (OD-15). The p.17 statement that the Scrutineer performs multi-dance calculations is reference only; its nesting in the text extraction should be confirmed visually. Depends on the OD-06 designations table (not built). Design only: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
